title: Groundwork mockup gallery manifest
description: Index of full-screen mockup candidate slots (screen x design-mode) scaffolded by designer/mockups/scaffold.py and filled by /groundwork:mockups. Lives at <design-dir>/mockups/manifest.json.

slug.description: Kebab-case design slug; folder name under ~/dev/designs/.

spec.description: Relative path (from the design dir) to the Spec JSON.

selection.description: Relative path to selection.json, written after gallery review (step e).

modes.description: The design-mode briefs that seed one candidate per screen.

brief.description: Path (from plugin root) to the mode brief md.

hint.description: One-line palette/type cue; brief is authoritative.

screens.description: Critical screens carried from the Spec's screens[].

slug.description: Kebab slug used as the HTML filename prefix.

slots.description: One slot per (screen x mode). The host agent authors HTML into each html_path.

html_path.description: Flat filename relative to the mockups dir (e.g. today-atmospheric-immersion.html). Flat, non-recursive; Groundwork's own gallery groups slots by screen_id.

status.description: pending = placeholder only; authored = host agent has written a real mockup.

delta.description: Optional review metadata that names this option's material difference and, for a small change, identifies the same-origin element the gallery should outline.

summary.description: Plain-language answer to: What changes in this option?

selector.description: Optional CSS selector for one small changed region. The gallery outlines the first match in expanded review.
